recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, soft-focus studio portrait of a man holding a brass trumpet against his chest. The lighting is diffused, creating a gentle glow on the skin and metallic surfaces. The background is a soft blue-to-lavender gradient, framed by a thin grey border.
coreVisualRelationships: The trumpet acts as a diagonal visual anchor across the lower-left quadrant.
The subject's direct gaze establishes an intimate connection with the viewer.
The white script lettering overlaps the subject's hair, creating depth.
The warm skin tones contrast against the cool-toned gradient background.
coreInvariants: Diagonal placement of the musical instrument
Thin outer border framing the composition

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered and tightly cropped from the chest up, filling most of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The golden trumpet held in the hands provides a high-contrast focal point in the lower half.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the subject's face, moves down the diagonal line of the trumpet, and then up to the script typography at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily in the upper corners around the head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm flesh tones and golden brass provide the primary warmth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool blue and lavender gradients in the background provide a calm contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow and white typography at the top provide bright highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-contrast, high-key lighting with soft transitions between values.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to soft pastels and warm metallics

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a fluid, handwritten script with varying line weights.
Secondary text uses a wide-tracked, all-caps geometric sans-serif.
Script flourishes extend horizontally to frame the subject's head.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'H' and 'A' in the script have elongated, expressive cross-strokes.
The 't' at the end of the script has a long, horizontal crossbar.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, organic script paired with rigid, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif for a balanced 80s look.

preserve: Wide tracking of the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, handwritten energy of the 80s era.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Futura Bold or ITC Avant Garde
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, wide-tracked subtitle style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus studio portrait of a man with dark hair holding a golden trumpet diagonally across his chest. Use a soft blue and lavender gradient background and high-key, diffused lighting. Frame the entire image with a thin grey border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a line of wide-tracked, yellow geometric sans-serif text at the very top. Below it, add a large, white, fluid cursive script name that slightly overlaps the top of the subject's hair.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting soft and diffused?
Does the script text overlap the hair?
Is the top text yellow and widely spaced?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the trumpet looks like a realistic brass instrument.
Verify the script is legible despite the flourishes.
Check that the border is uniform on all sides.
Confirm the color palette remains within the warm/cool pastel range.
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft-focus portrait + diagonal instrument + gradient background + script/sans-serif typographic pairing.
